upgrades.title: A clearer home screen
upgrades.summary: See attendance, tomorrow's class, alerts, progress, and today's activity at a glance.

upgrades.title: Smoother pop-ups and scrolling
upgrades.summary: Screens open, close, and scroll more consistently, with easier dismiss gestures and clearer actions.

upgrades.title: Simpler holidays and curricula
upgrades.summary: Vacation periods replace holiday placeholders, while curriculum changes are carried over more safely.

upgrades.title: More dependable reminders
upgrades.summary: Notifications are filtered more carefully and updates are handled more safely.

upgrades.title: A clearer activity history
upgrades.summary: Attendance changes and subject edits now appear in an easier-to-follow activity timeline.

fixes.title: Section labels stay in place
fixes.summary: Section labels now pin neatly below the app bar while you scroll through Settings, Subjects, and Timetable.

fixes.title: A more reliable Manage tab
fixes.summary: Manage windows scroll correctly, borders stay complete, Add Slot is easier to find, and Edit Slot is clearer.

fixes.title: A tidier attendance dashboard
fixes.summary: Home scrolling, Detox Day, Overall Attendance, and the Max Percentage chart now fit together more cleanly.

fixes.title: More accurate activity entries
fixes.summary: Attendance actions no longer create duplicates, stay in order, and keep undo and redo behavior intact.

fixes.title: Safer data and reminders
fixes.summary: Delete and restore actions are safer, failures are easier to notice, and finished SGT subjects no longer send reminders.

upgrades.title: App Font
upgrades.summary: Personalise from a variety of stylish fonts to make the app feel truly yours. Your selection is saved automatically.

upgrades.title: Theme and Appearance
upgrades.summary: Pick an accent color that suits your style, with Red, Orange, and Green appearance choices alongside the default.

upgrades.title: Subjects tab
upgrades.summary: Track your progress with a compact report and easy-to-read category rings that show exactly where you stand.

upgrades.title: Sounds and feedback
upgrades.summary: Enjoy more distinct confirmation tones and improved volume for clear, satisfying feedback.

upgrades.title: Nav Bar Style
upgrades.summary: Choose a fixed or floating navigation bar. The floating bar tucks neatly above the bottom edge, hides as you scroll down, and returns as you scroll up—your preference stays saved.

fixes.title: Confirmation messages
fixes.summary: Saving, editing, or removing items now shows a clear message that disappears when you close the window, so you're never left with outdated information.

upgrades.summary: Open the separate logbook from Home, choose a preloaded department and its placement dates, and mark that department’s attendance independently. Overlap warnings keep each department separately trackable.

upgrades.summary: View current and predicted progress by department. Optional roster-duty marks belong to that department’s placement, and a one-day-before reminder can appear in the app and arrive as a remote push.

upgrades.summary: Filter Academic categories, official Integrated Teaching, actual added subject or parent names when available, Ward, and Small Group Teaching independently.

fixes.title: Home dashboard loads reliably
fixes.summary: Fixed a render-order issue that could leave the Home page blank when Today at a Glance evaluated attendance marks.

fixes.title: A smoother Logbook date picker
fixes.summary: Choose Logbook dates with the same swipeable date wheel used in Academic attendance, with clearer in-sheet navigation.

fixes.title: Consistent dashboard ordering and controls
fixes.summary: Today at a Glance now treats each attendance mark as completed, sorts unfinished Academic, Clinical, and Block sessions first, then completed marks, in chronological order. The Home action buttons are equal-sized, compact, fixed-height, and long Tomorrow details scroll inside the button.

fixes.summary: The Logbook has a more engaging date-and-attendance layout, with a styled Back to Home action where it is easy to reach.
